title: Identify remedial actions
goal: What the analysis found has become work or has been dropped on purpose: each action named with an owner and a measure, each dropped finding recorded as dropped, and nothing left as an interesting number nobody acts on.

steps.do: For each finding, write the one action it calls for with the process it changes, an owner and the measure that will show it worked, and open a handoff for each.
For each finding nobody will act on, record that it was dropped and why, so it is not rediscovered and analyzed again next quarter.
Write when each action's measure will be read and by whom, and put that date on the process record the action changes.
Raise to the strategy lead which action to take first, and to the founder anything that would undo a decision in force.

done_criteria.check: Does every finding either have an action with an owner and a measure, or a written record that it was dropped and why?
